title: Multimodal Labeling
subtitle: Text, images and audio, with review built in
description: A Rust + React labeling platform with configurable schemas, multi-annotator agreement and optional model-assisted pre-labeling. One Docker image to self-host.
longDescription: A Rust + React labeling platform with configurable schemas, multi-annotator agreement and optional model-assisted pre-labeling. One Docker image to self-host. Rewritten from the original Flask application in 2026, keeping annotation, review and export in one workspace.
features: Configurable schemas for text, image and audio classification
Optional model-assisted pre-labeling and built-in login
results: 2026 Rust and React rewrite with import, annotation, review and export
